scheme_name: National Fellowship for Students with Disabilities
other_conditions: Must have at least 40% disability as defined under the Rights of Persons with Disabilities Act, 2016
Must possess a valid disability certificate issued by the competent authority
Must have secured admission to an M. Phil. or Ph.D. program in a university/institution recognized by the University Grants Commission (UGC)
Must have a good academic record
benefits_summary: Provides monthly financial assistance of ₹31,000 for Junior Research Fellows and ₹35,500 for Senior Research Fellows for up to five years.
